reason: The first evaluation scored python-docx K4 outputs as preservation failures. python-docx does not see text inside w:ins, so it saved the target paragraph untouched; the evaluator reported 'target paragraph not found with the expected texts' as a lost attribution, confusing an incomplete task with damage.
rule: Inside the target paragraph: when the declared edit is present, characters are judged as declared in PROTOCOL.md; when the paragraph is unchanged, it must equal the source character by character; when it was edited but not as declared, its revisions are judged on the oracle's revision facts like every other paragraph.
